versions.name: Parker Mountain Scout Camp
versions.summary: A Spirit of Adventure Council scout camp property in Strafford, New Hampshire, set on Big Willey Pond and Little Willey Pond amid several hundred wooded acres, long used for group camping and outdoor education.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council corrected to Spirit of Adventure Council (the property's owner, formed from the Boston Minuteman and Yankee Clipper councils). The slice's two entries, 'Parker Mountain Scout Camp' and 'Parker Mountain Scout Reservation', are the same Strafford property on Big and Little Willey Pond and are recorded here once. Status set not_operating: the property is council-owned and listed under council rentals but has not been run as a council BSA summer camp for decades and is now leased to the Beam Center. Coordinates from the verified camp-entrance point, approximate (US Census returned no match for the street address); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, corrected owning council, and dormant (leased-out, no council program) status verified; de-duplicated the slice's Camp/Reservation pair into one record; program_types left empty as it runs no current council program; features unsurveyed.
